repositioning: Yes, major. Relume is no longer export-only. It now has a 'Publish' path (beta) that takes a project from brief to a live hosted site with custom domain and SSL handled by Relume, alongside the original 'Export' path. notes: Product is alive and actively publishing. Confidence is LOW on pricing specifically: Tickeron's canonical membership page (tickeron.com/app/generalinfo/pricing) is client-rendered and served no readable content, /pricing/ and /subscription/ both 404, and browser automation to tickeron.com was blocked. The figures above come from Tickeron's own promotional article on tickeron.com — vendor-owned, so acceptable as primary, but they are SALE prices tied to a Labor Day promotion and may not reflect the standing rate. Recommendation: do not publish exact Tickeron prices in the card until someone can read the logged-in membership page; describe the product structure (Signals / AI Robots / AI Robots Unlimited, annual billing, 14-day trial) instead. What IS certain is that the card's four monthly persona tiers are no longer how Tickeron sells. Separately: this is a financial product and the card's existing hedging about probabilistic signals should be kept.
